picks.annotation: Omg what an item for Rem. 40% Movement slow + Pillow -45% + Mystic Slow = frozen in time + Huge dmg spike

picks.name: Golden Goose Egg
picks.annotation: The permanent buffs SUCK. Rem is like the only character this item is good for. After 30 mins you're likely a low 1-3% inscrease on stats. It's mostly to save to 10mins sell early.

picks.name: Monster Rounds
picks.annotation: Bro ur pillow one shots camps, ur clear is amazing, this is an absolute waste. Only maybe buy if vs graves/mcginnus

picks.name: Heroic Aura
picks.annotation: If you rush upgrade Lil Helpers to tier 2, you can shred towers very fast.   @boundless.spirit told me a strat to max 3 and split push towers. Very fast for macro'ing but is a gamble.

picks.name: Alchemical Fire
picks.annotation: Soild for urn fights and supporting gun carries. I'll only get if I have 3~ heavy gun carries that are currently carrying the match.

picks.name: Mystic Shot
picks.annotation: Free spirit scaling gun dmg every 8 seconds. Potential to do around 300~ dmg late game.

picks.name: Divine Barrier
picks.annotation: Must have IMO. Best cleanse in the game (better than dispel). Get's rid of ultimates, non-stun, status effects. Use in TG for benefits.

picks.name: Healing Nova
picks.annotation: I'd prefer using base-kit Tag Along w/healing booster to do my heals. Adding this is TOO much healing that it's buying too much into something Rem can already do soildly. Extremely bad mid-late game.

picks.name: Healing Tempo
picks.annotation: I'll hold off on buying this until extreme late game. (is like the last thing I ever buy)

picks.name: Spirit Resilience
picks.annotation: This item is good with characters that have high health, lifesteal, and can stay in the fight for LONG periods of time. Not for you. Also holy nerf.

picks.name: Cursed Relic
picks.annotation: GREAT item for stopping long lasting Ults. Haze, Dynamo, Lash, etc. (is an interupt!)

picks.name: Rapid Recharge
picks.annotation: Small nerf but more Pillows = more dmg output.

picks.name: Boundless Spirit
picks.annotation: Dmg Spike #1. 15% spirit power (it's better to get when have already existing spirit power since scales % wise)

picks.name: Spirit Burn
picks.annotation: If decay isn't enough anti-heal, I'll buy this too.

picks.name: Healbane
picks.annotation: Need if they have heals in early lane (VICTOR/Giest) Lil Helpers proc this.

picks.name: Enchanter's Emblem
picks.annotation: I only really buy when I'm facing spirit in lane. Been buying less and relying on Tag Along with Echo Shard.

picks.name: Rebuttal
picks.annotation: Melee counter - PSA: usually you'll get slammed into a wall against Abe/Venator, stunning you. Get any debuff resist (WS, DR, Spellbreaker, Scourge) and you "should" be able to parry it.

picks.name: Knockdown
picks.annotation: "Anti-fly/movement" This cancels ults like lash, mina, mcginn, bebop and MORE
